description: One wallet's sports and esports markets, the rows behind the profile positions table. status=closed (the default) is the Closed tab: no live leg, or the market has a winner, or the open row's cost is under 0.10 USD. status=open is the Open tab: a live leg whose cost is at least 0.10 USD and that has no winner. An open row with no winner and no stored cost is in status=all only. cost and realized_pnl are the stored figures the profile labels Cost and Realized, each an exact decimal with value, unit USD, scale and basis; null means not stored, never zero. resolved_at is null when the market has not settled, including a closed position on a market that still trades. Ordered by last_trade_at descending, then condition_id descending; a row with no last_trade_at comes after every dated row. get_positions stays the open board and leaves resolved markets out.

address.description: Wallet address (0x...), username, or trd_-prefixed trader id

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; it is bound to the same status

status.description: open, closed (default) or all. closed is the profile Closed tab. all is one time order, newest last trade first, not open rows before closed rows
